title: Abu Simbel day trip from Aswan
standfirst: A full day to the temples of Ramesses II and Nefertari, by road from Aswan, leaving before dawn. It is one of our [[up]].

sections.heading: The day
paragraphs: Pickup from your ship or hotel in Aswan before dawn, about three to four hours by road to Abu Simbel, around two hours at the temples, then the drive back to Aswan by early afternoon.

faqs.q: Can I do this on a cruise day?
faqs.a: Yes, on the day your cruise is in Aswan; the early start fits around the ship’s programme.

seoTitle: Abu Simbel day trip from Aswan
seoDescription: A day trip by road from Aswan to the temples of Abu Simbel: the day, what is included and how to book.
